mentions.name: OpenTelemetry Java service injector binary
mentions.description: This binary automatically instruments every Java service running on a Linux host machine with the OpenTelemetry Java Agent. It extends the approach of the existing opentelemetry-injector project by supporting multiple service names for different services, covering Tomcat, regular systemd services, and services running inside Docker containers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a binary that will instrument every Java service running on Linux host machine with OpenTelemetry Java Agent.

Kinda like this (https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-injector) but with support of having multiple service name for different services. This includes tomcat, normal systemd services and also services running inside docker containers.
